usage: The word 掃把 (sou3 baa2) is a noun used to refer to a broom, a tool for sweeping floors.
It can be used as a subject or object in a sentence, e.g. '我買咗新掃把' (I bought a new broom).
When speaking about cleaning, 掃把 is commonly paired with verbs like 掃 (sou3), meaning 'to sweep'.
It is a countable noun and can take measure words like 把 (baa2).
You can also describe the broom by adding adjectives before the noun, for example, '舊掃把' (old broom).
